# id | where | planted defect | refused by (kind)
1 | ctl_decode | branch offset bit 11 is read from word bit 20 instead of word bit 7 | differential 2 (pc), property 41
2 | ctl_decode | the shift decoder ignores word bit 30, so SRAI reads as SRLI | differential 3 (register), property 41
3 | ctl_decode | 12-bit immediates are zero-extended instead of sign-extended | differential 3 (register), property 41
4 | ctl_decode | the jump decoder drops offset bits 19 to 12 | differential 2 (pc), property 41
5 | step_v | register 0 is an ordinary register, so a write to it lands | differential 6 (register 0), hand-computed case 22
6 | step_v | ADDIW leaves the upper 32 bits clear instead of copying bit 31 | differential 3 (register), hand-computed case 32
# trap profile (command mcontrols): step and case numbers are those of seed 1, 20000 steps
7 | mctl_after | a trap saves pc + 4 in mepc instead of pc | differential 13 (mepc) at step 0, hand-computed case 13
8 | mctl_after | ECALL from machine mode reports cause 8 instead of 11 | differential 14 (mcause) at step 5, hand-computed case 36
9 | mstep_v | MRET leaves MIE as it was instead of copying MPIE into it | differential 11 (mstatus) at step 31, hand-computed case 53
10 | mstep_v | CSRRS and CSRRSI with rs1 = 0 count as a write, so reading a read-only CSR traps | differential 1 (result code) at step 15, hand-computed case 16
11 | mstep_v | CSRRC and CSRRCI set the bits instead of clearing them | differential 13 (mepc) at step 1, hand-computed case 23
12 | mctl_decode | the decoder sign-extends the 12-bit CSR number | differential 1 (result code) at step 15, property 42 at round 0
